$comment: Evolution rule: schema changes must be additive-only. New optional fields may be added at any time without a version bump. Required fields may not be removed or changed to optional. schema_version field gates future breaking changes.
title: Public Export Manifest
description: Machine-readable contract governing which artifact families are safe to publish, under what license, and with what redaction rules. Consumed by the export gate (Phase 05) and publishing phases (06-09). Schema version: 1.0.0.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this manifest schema (e.g. '1.0.0'). Gates future breaking changes.

conference.description: Conference slug matching the conferences/<slug>/ workspace (e.g. 'neurips2025').

release.description: Release identity. source_sha is required; other fields are stamped by Phase 08.

source_sha.description: Git SHA of the source commit for this export. Empty string is a valid placeholder until Phase 08 stamps it.

conference_name.description: Optional display name of the conference, shown by the site and the hub (v6.0 Phase 6; without it they show the slug).

released_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp of the release.

families.description: Per-family export contracts. Each family carries mandatory safety/identity fields and optional operational fields.

excluded_families.description: Optional. Storage-manifest families that are not published, each with the reason. Written by 'conference-pipeline release init'; the operator promotes a family by moving it into 'families'. Never read by the exporter.

id.description: Unique identifier for this export family (matches storage_manifest_id or is derivative).

private_path.description: Path to the private source artifacts relative to the conference workspace.

public_path.description: Destination path in the public release bundle (may contain {bundle} placeholder).

storage_manifest_id.description: ID of the corresponding artifact family in storage_manifest.json.

redistribution_status.description: Safety gate value. 'allowed' = publishable without additional operator review. 'caution' = publishable but requires explicit operator acknowledgement on each export run. 'prohibited' = blocked from export by the gate.

provenance.description: Source provenance category for this artifact family.

redaction_rules.description: Optional redaction of each matching file's bundle copy, before checksumming. A string names a legacy rule and has no effect. An object is applied (v6.0 Phase 6, spec section 6.5): json_field replaces a JSON pointer's value; absolute_path makes workspace paths relative and redacts other home paths; relink rewrites Drive links through link_map and drops unmapped ones; marker_text redacts publishing markers; inline_assets makes each local image an HTML file loads a data: URI; figure_links replaces each local figure in deck Markdown with a line naming its paper (from the deck's asset_inventory.json) and linking it through catalog (a figure the pipeline drew, under assets/generated/, is named as one); pdf_links removes a PDF's link annotations that are not public https links, leaving its pages unchanged; drop_preamble drops text above a Markdown file's first # title. glob matches the path relative to the family's private_path. The workspace original is never changed.

large_media_policy.description: Optional policy for handling large media files (e.g. cdn-only delivery, size thresholds).

format_contract.description: Optional contract specifying the output format constraints for this family.

include_globs.description: Optional glob patterns specifying which files to include in the export.

exclude_globs.description: Optional glob patterns specifying which files to exclude from the export.

cdn_base_url.description: Optional base URL for CDN delivery of large media. Placeholder until Phase 08 stamps the real URL.

checksum_required.description: Whether a SHA-256 checksum must be computed and recorded for each exported file.

public_export_notes.description: Optional operator notes on export scope, redaction intent, or caution acknowledgement requirements.

glob_overrides.description: Optional per-glob overrides for mixed families where different file subsets carry different license or redistribution status.

globOverride.description: Per-glob override of the family-level redistribution_status and license.

glob.description: Glob pattern this override applies to (relative to private_path).

redistribution_status.description: Override redistribution status for files matching this glob.

license.description: Override license identifier for files matching this glob.

notes.description: Optional notes explaining this glob-level override.
